summary: Other Agents character contact sheet v1.0 for Adventures of Patch. The sheet frames non-Patch, agent-shaped bots with a top banner, purpose statement, core rules, six role-based design-pattern columns (Nav-Bot, Data-Bot, Comm-Bot, Ops-Bot, Sec-Bot, Log-Bot), expression and pose examples, a patterns/anti-patterns panel, an environment-fit scene, an interaction guide, and footer notes. It is intended as a positive style and role reference for other agents while keeping them clearly robotic and visually distinct from Patch.

composition: Landscape contact sheet with a dark navy top banner reading 'ADVENTURES OF PATCH | OTHER AGENTS - CHARACTER CONTACT SHEET v1.0'.
Top-left purpose statement explains that Other Agents are non-Patch, agent-shaped bots that are clearly robotic, not organic, not Patch-shaped, and not wearing hoodies or teal.
Top core rules: clearly robotic and agent-shaped, no hoodies or teal bodies, distinct silhouettes and color accents, screen faces or simple graphic eyes, friendly/capable/purpose-driven.
Central design-patterns grid with six role columns, each showing a main bot, alternate variant, accent-color swatches, and key-shape swatches.
Lower-left expression strip with seven screen-face labels: Neutral, Happy, Thinking, Surprised, Concerned, Excited, Acknowledging.
Lower-left pose strip with seven body-language labels: Neutral/Idle, Explaining, Thinking, Pointing/Directing, Working/Focused, Confirming, Helping/Offering.
Right-hand patterns/anti-patterns panel: green 'PATTERNS - DO THIS' row and red 'ANTI-PATTERNS - DON'T DO THIS' row.
Bottom-right environment-fit scene showing several other agents in a mission control room.
Bottom banner reads 'OTHER AGENTS ARE NOT PATCH. THEY ARE CLEARLY BOTS.' with version 'v1.0' and date '2025-05-13'.
design_patterns: NAV-BOT (Navigator/Planner): blue compass/wayfinding accents, rounded body, main bot and shorter side variants, circular and pill key shapes.
DATA-BOT (Analyst/Researcher): purple chart/graph accents, main bot with data-display chest, side variants, rounded and square key shapes.
COMM-BOT (Communications/Liaison): green radio/signal accents, main bot with broadcast-style head, side variants, rounded and square key shapes.
OPS-BOT (Operations/Executor): orange wrench/tool accents, main bot with tool chest, side variants, pill and rectangular key shapes.
SEC-BOT (Security/Gatekeeper): red shield accents, main bot with badge-shaped chest, side variants, shield and rounded key shapes.
LOG-BOT (Recorder/Archivist): yellow/gold document/folder accents, main bot with log-book chest, side variants, circular and square key shapes.
expressions: Seven screen-face icons in a horizontal strip: Neutral, Happy, Thinking, Surprised, Concerned, Excited, Acknowledging.
poses: Seven body-language examples in a horizontal strip: Neutral/Idle, Explaining, Thinking, Pointing/Directing, Working/Focused, Confirming, Helping/Offering.
patterns_do_this: Use role icons to signal function.
Maintain distinct silhouettes and accent colors.
anti_patterns: Do not make other agents look like Patch: no hoodies, no teal bodies.
Do not make other agents human or organic.
Do not make designs generic or indistinct.
Avoid threatening or aggressive design language.
Avoid poor contrast for screens or icons.
Avoid inconsistent style mixing across agents.
environment_fit: Illustrated mission control room with multiple other agents at consoles and screens.
Shows other agents working as peers and specialists in a Patch-world setting.
interaction_guide: Work with Patch as peers or specialists.
Show intent through gestures and face.
notes: Create new agent types when a story needs an unrepresented capability.
Keep designs modular to scale across decks and environments.
Favor readability at thumbnail and full-screen sizes.
Maintain visual consistency with the Adventures of Patch style: clean lines, bold shapes, friendly energy.

positive_constraints: Other agents must be clearly robotic and agent-shaped, not human-shaped or organic.
No hoodies, no teal Patch-identity bodies, and no Patch crossbody bag or '>' symbol.
Assign distinct silhouettes and color accents to support role clarity: nav blue, data purple, comm green, ops orange, sec red, log yellow/gold.
Use screen faces or simple graphic eyes; keep expressions readable.
Give each agent a role icon or functional detail that signals its job.
Keep other agents friendly, capable, and purpose-driven.
Place other agents naturally in mission control rooms, labs, workshops, and field bases.
Maintain the Adventures of Patch clean editorial style: thick rounded outlines, simplified shapes, soft controlled shading, and uncluttered composition.
negative_constraints: Do not make other agents human, organic, photoreal, or human-proportioned.
Do not give other agents Patch's teal hoodie, hood antennae, off-white face panel, crossbody bag, or full silhouette.
Do not let other agents use the '>' symbol or teal as the main body color.
Do not create Patch clones, Patch-shaped sidekicks, or other agents that could be mistaken for Patch.
Do not make other agents generic, indistinct, threatening, aggressive, or over-cluttered.
Do not use poor icon/screen contrast or unclear role signage.
Do not mix rendering styles, photoreal finishes, anime, glossy 3D, or plush textures with other agents.
Do not treat this contact sheet as authorization to create new canonical agent classes without further review.
